body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Anadem(www.anadem.net.tw) introduced 7-inch Android 2.2(Froyo) Tablet PC 'F07' with with MSM7227 Processor of Qualcomm at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
